name: D existing Niyama deadline chunk component versus tuned fixed cap
question: Does an existing completion-deadline chunk principle improve complete service over the tuned fixed cap in the observed completion-limited domain?
reason: Effective matched-prefill timing01 pulse changed phase transitions without frozen service benefit; highrate fixed comparisons have only completion misses. Existing TTLT baseline has not been executed here. This is a prior-art baseline development screen, not a new-signal or novelty experiment.
fixed_selection: 1024 selected by unchanged full joint SLO goodput from the already closed small fixed development set; no per-segment hindsight algorithm.
component_scope: Niyama chunk-size/decode-deadline component adapted to vLLM FCFS only; not the entire original system. No original hybrid sorting/relegation/admission/KV manager is transplanted.
length_input: Each request declared fixed max_tokens from min=max/ignoreEOS contract, passed as original num_decode_tokens metadata path. No future emitted content, actual natural-EOS length, arrivals or routes observed. Natural-EOS setting not tested.
deadline: a + max(observed_first_output-a, 20-declared_output_tokens*tau) + (observed_outputs+1)*tau; minimum over ALL current native decoders. Preserve source late-prefill rebasing and cumulative slack, no K filtering.
objective_mapping: tau31.25ms derived once from (completion20-TTFT4)/maximum declared length512; internal TTFT allocation4s for512 and8s for384. Evaluator remains joint4s/100ms/20s. Internal8s is NOT a relaxed measured TTFT SLO and no hard TTFT/max-gap/TTLT guarantee is claimed.
low_memory_rule: (current_native_free_blocks*block_size)//32 < 1000; read-only feature, no KV policy change.
pure_prefill_cap: max(0,selected_total_tier-current_D); native total4096 unchanged and ALL native decodes must still execute.
search_adaptation: Enumerate original ten total tiers and take largest predicted-feasible tier. The local two-regime fit has observed512->768 declines up to2.987ms, making original binary-search monotonicity unsafe. Enumeration preserves maximum-feasible intent; source minimum-tier fallback unchanged; no fit clipping/monotonic envelope/new model.
prefill_context_adaptation: Current first unfinished prefill in native running order, else waiting order, replaces original reordered heap top. Its computed tokens estimate is preserved as source head proxy, not a claimed exact multi-prefill context. Log actual executed prefill context separately.
zero_prefill_rule: Nonpositive slack or no feasible tier returns min-total128 minus D, hence P0 ifD>=128. Existing decodes always progress, no arrival pause/reject/order change. Source fallback retained without new aging/controller. Finite fixed-output input continues to full drain or original180s timeout; no general waiting/SLO bound claimed.
calibration: Existing five real native training runs, five reverse held-out runs; same two linear model family with total=P+D redundant column removed. Actual P/D/contexts, hostengine completion label. No GPU profiling, no additional prediction model. Intended online<=512/>512 branch used, correcting fitter>513 exclusion boundary; zero observed513 rows. Per-run errors retained. Nonmonotonic diagnostic remains in calibration JSON; enumeration resolves search assumption only, not model error.
controls: Unchanged parent normal arrival/add/output/drain loop, BF16OLMoE, engine resources/native scheduler patch. Candidate compute and logging overhead included. Both policy warm runs precede all formal measurements; no changed kernels/precision or extra forward/synchronization.
fair_timing: Require no new formal compilation/capture/autotuning; report observed warm/formal total-tier and actualP coverage. Formal compile is interpretability failure, not mechanism loss. Preserve all failures and attempts, no automatic rerun.
decision: Both reversed pairs require all arrivals valid complete, actual cap-binding execution difference, full jointU>=3%, raw output throughput not down, TTFT/flow/per-request-maxgap p95<=1.05reference, and no added100ms gap-failure IDs. Retain all raw metrics, qualification migrations and harmed requests even if gate fails.
stopping: Zero actual change: one interface/opportunity diagnosis, no expansion. Negative/subgate/inconsistent complete effect: stop this mapping, no automatic tau/margin/cap tuning; investigate only an observed new explanation. A positive result means an existing principle has utility here, NOT a D contribution, full Niyama reproduction, or independent confirmation. No second-model/parameter matrix based on this screen.
resources: One D process under existing host-wide sharedflock;7200s boundedwait;2warm+4formal;no automatic retries. Check4GiBrootreserve beforequeue and afterlock;release on exit. No fee/remaining-budget telemetry.
output_contract: Identical external arrivals/prompts/fixed counts; counts do not imply identical output content/routes/computation/quality.
